questions.question: The Registrar ___ judicial notices to all departments daily at 10:00 AM.
questions.explanation: Time marker 'daily' ek routine ya scheduled duty ko show karta hai jiske liye Simple Present chahiye. Third-person singular subject ('The Registrar') ke saath verb mein '-es' lagta hai ('dispatches'). Present Continuous (A) ongoing action ke liye hota hai aur Simple Past (C) past events ke liye.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-01: Habitual actions, daily routines aur universal facts ke liye Simple Present use hota hai (S + V1/V_s/es).
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: The High Court Registry ___ the verified compliance report yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday afternoon' ek definite past time marker hai jo Simple Past (V2: 'dispatched') demand karta hai. Present Perfect (A) definite past markers ke saath kabhi nahi lagta. Past Perfect (C) ke liye sentence mein kisi doosre past event ka reference hona zaroori hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-05: Jab action past ke kisi stated time par complete hua ho (yesterday, ago, last week), toh Simple Past (V2) mandatory hota hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: The scrutiny board ___ all the uploaded verification documents already.
questions.explanation: Marker 'already' aise action ko dikhata hai jo present se pehle complete ho chuka hai aur abhi bhi relevant hai, isliye yahan Present Perfect lagega. 'The scrutiny board' ek collective singular subject hai jiske saath auxiliary 'has' + V3 ('has reviewed') aayega.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-03: Present Perfect (has/have + V3) unspecified past time par complete huye action ko present validity ke saath express karta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: The administration ___ the official examination instructions tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 'Tomorrow morning' ek future time marker hai jo aane wale event ko dikhata hai, isliye Simple Future ('will publish') use hoga. Option B past hai aur Option C present perfect hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-09: Simple Future (will/shall + V1) future time mein hone wale projected action ko denote karta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: The System Assistant ___ the server firewall configurations since 9:00 AM.
questions.explanation: 'Since 9:00 AM' batata hai ki action past mein shuru hua aur abhi tak continue ho raha hai, isliye yahan Present Perfect Continuous ('has been testing') aayega. Present Continuous (A) sirf abhi ka action dikhata hai, 'since' wali starting duration ko nahi.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-04: Present Perfect Continuous (has/have been + V_ing) past mein shuru hokar abhi tak chalne wale action ko express karta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: At 8:30 PM yesterday, the technical staff ___ the central database backup.
questions.explanation: 'At 8:30 PM yesterday' past ke ek specific moment ko mark karta hai jab action actively chal raha tha. Plural collective noun 'staff' ke saath plural auxiliary 'were' lagegi ('were performing').
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-06: Past Continuous (was/were + V_ing) past ke kisi specific point par chal rahe action ko depict karta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: The candidate did not ___ the required character certificate along with the application.
questions.explanation: Negative Simple Past sentences mein 'did' auxiliary verb hoti hai jo past tense carry karti hai. Isliye main lexical verb hamesha base form V1 ('enclose') mein aani chahiye. Option A ('enclosed') double past ki galti create karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-05: Negative Simple Past mein Subject + did + not + V1 use hota hai (V2 nahi).
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: Identify the grammatically correct sentence:

options.text: The committee has concluded the hearing two days ago.
The committee concluded the hearing two days ago.
The committee had concluded the hearing two days ago.
The committee was concluding the hearing two days ago.

questions.explanation: 'Two days ago' ek explicit past time marker hai jo Present Perfect ('has concluded') ko allow nahi karta. Iske liye Simple Past (V2: 'concluded') zaroori hai. Past Perfect (C) kisi doosre past reference point ke bina galat hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-05: Definite past markers ('ago', 'yesterday', 'in 2021') strictly Simple Past require karte hain.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: The senior judicial clerk ___ the legal terminology used in the petition thoroughly.
questions.explanation: 'Understand' cognition ka ek stative verb hai jo mental state show karta hai, koi physical dynamic action nahi. Standard English mein stative verbs continuous forms (-ing) nahi lete, isliye Simple Present ('understands') sahi hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-01 Note: Stative verbs (know, believe, understand, belong) Continuous tenses ki jagah Simple tenses mein use hote hain.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: The audit team ___ the financial vouchers before the chief auditor inspected the premises.
questions.explanation: Jab past mein do actions huye hon, toh jo action pehle complete hua (earlier past event) wo Past Perfect (had + V3: 'had verified') leta hai. Baad mein hone wala action Simple Past ('inspected') leta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-07: Past Perfect doosre past event se pehle complete huye action ko denote karta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'always' with Present Continuous to convey emotional irritation about an obstinate habit:

options.text: He always wakes up at 5:00 AM for his morning studies.
He is always interrupting the advocate during oral arguments.
The sun is always rising in the east.
Judges are always delivering impartial verdicts.

questions.explanation: Waise toh 'always' routines ke liye Simple Present mein aata hai, lekin jab speaker kisi irritating ya bar-bar hone wale obstinate habit par annoyance ya emotion express kare, tab Present Continuous ('is always interrupting') use hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-02 Note: 'Always' ke saath Present Continuous neutral routine ki jagah annoying ya exaggerated habit ko express karta hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01

questions.question: By 5:00 PM this evening, the administrative division ___ all digital certificates.
questions.explanation: 'By 5:00 PM this evening' future ki ek clear completion deadline set karta hai. Future ke kisi point se pehle complete hone wale action ke liye Future Perfect (will have + V3: 'will have dispatched') zaroori hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule T-11: Future Perfect (will have + V3) us action ko indicate karta hai jo future deadline se pehle complete ho chuka hoga.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L01
